events.place: Historic Downtown Cedar City
events.note: Lighting and fireworks at 6pm. Free.
events.description: Cedar City's holiday celebration in the historic downtown, with the lighting and fireworks at 6pm. Free admission.

events.name: Festival City Christmas Market
events.place: 100 W Center St
events.note: Thursdays–Saturdays: produce, baked goods, handmade gifts.
events.description: A free holiday market at the Festival City Farmers Market site, held Thursdays to Saturdays through Dec 19. Local vendors sell produce, baked goods and handmade items.

events.description: Cedar City's Holiday Tree Jubilee, open Nov 28 and Nov 30–Dec 1.

events.name: Storytime Tuesday at Frontier Homestead

events.note: Every Tuesday.

events.name: Bryce Canyon Full Moon Hike
events.place: Bryce Canyon National Park (meeting spot varies)
events.note: Free ranger hike; reserve on Recreation.gov (released 14 and 5 days ahead).
events.description: A ranger's-choice full moon hike at sunset that may stay on the rim or descend steep, rocky trails into the canyon. Reservations open on Recreation.gov in two phases, 14 and 5 days in advance.

events.name: Bryce Canyon Full Moon Hike (December)
events.place: Bryce Canyon National Park (meeting spot varies)
events.note: Free ranger hike; reserve on Recreation.gov.
events.description: December's ranger-led full moon hike at Bryce Canyon, offered at sunset as weather permits. Tickets release on Recreation.gov 14 and 5 days in advance.

events.name: Talon Craft Fair

events.description: Talon Craft Fair at Canyon View High School, Cedar City. $2.

events.note: Free.
events.description: parkrun Turkey Trot 5K at Cedar City parkrun course. Free.

events.note: $4, or $20 per family.
events.description: Holidays at the Homestead at Frontier Homestead State Park, 635 N Main St. $4, or $20 per family.

events.name: Lights at the Homestead

events.note: Free.
events.description: Lights at the Homestead at Frontier Homestead State Park, 635 N Main St. Free.

events.name: Storybook Parade

events.note: Free. Route runs east on Center St, then north on Main St to 400 North.
events.description: A Cedar City tradition where children's books come to life with floats, music and costumed characters.

events.name: Cedar City Farmers Market (North)
events.place: Design & Flooring parking lot, 2232 N Main St
events.note: Saturdays through Dec 5.
events.description: Farm products, prepared foods and handmade goods at the north Cedar City Saturday market.

events.name: Dancing with the Cedar Community Stars
events.place: Heritage Center Theater, 105 N 100 East
events.description: Iron County community stars pair with experienced dancers in a family-friendly competition raising money for the Iron County Children's Justice Center.

events.name: SUMA First Friday
events.place: Southern Utah Museum of Art, 13 S 300 W
events.description: A free First Friday evening at the Southern Utah Museum of Art on the SUU campus.

events.name: A Very SUMA Holiday Sale
events.place: Southern Utah Museum of Art, 13 S 300 W
events.description: A holiday art and gift sale at the Southern Utah Museum of Art.

events.name: 86th Annual Handel's Messiah
events.place: Heritage Center Theater, 105 N 100 East
events.note: Free, but tickets are required.
events.description: The Orchestra of Southern Utah and community singers perform Handel's Messiah in Cedar City's long-running holiday tradition.

events.name: Brian Head Holiday Lighting Ceremony
events.place: Bristlecone Park Pavilion, 535 S Vasels Rd, Brian Head
events.description: Brian Head Town's annual holiday lighting with hot cocoa, cookies and Santa, about 30 miles from Cedar City.

events.name: Parowan Christmas in the Country
events.place: Iron County Fair Building & Main Street, Parowan
events.note: Bazaar Fri 10am–5pm and Sat 10am–4pm; Santa's Parade Sat 10am; candlelight walking parade Sat 6pm.
events.description: Parowan's holiday weekend: a holiday bazaar at the Iron County Fair Building, Santa's Parade down Main Street Saturday morning and a candlelight walking parade and town lighting Saturday evening.
know: Bring your own light or candle to join the 6pm candlelight parade (line up at 500 N Main).

events.name: Parowan Winter Wonderland Chamber Nights
events.place: Parowan Main Street Park
events.description: Free Winter Wonderland evenings hosted by the Parowan chamber at Main Street Park on three December Saturdays.

events.name: Bryce Canyon Christmas Bird Count
events.place: Bryce Canyon Visitor Center (meet first)
events.note: Free; register by emailing the park contact listed on the NPS page. Park entrance fee applies.
events.description: Join park staff and volunteers counting birds across Bryce Canyon for Audubon's long-running Christmas Bird Count. Meet first at the visitor center.

events.name: Bryce Canyon Geology Ranger Talk
events.place: Sunset Point, Bryce Canyon National Park
events.description: A short ranger talk on Bryce Canyon's hoodoos and geology at the alcove to the right of Sunset Point. About 20 minutes; wheelchair accessible.
events.note: Daily except Nov 26, Dec 10 and Dec 25. Park entrance fee applies.
know: Cancelled for thunderstorms, low wind chill or staffing; confirm at the visitor center that day.

events.name: Winter Solstice at SUMA
events.place: Southern Utah Museum of Art, 13 S 300 W
events.description: The Southern Utah Museum of Art marks the longest nights of the year with storytelling, music performances and traditional solstice activities.
events.note: Free. Soup, rolls, cookies and cider served.

events.name: SUU Ceramics Guild Holiday Sale
events.place: Sharwan Smith Student Center (Living Room), Southern Utah University
events.description: SUU ceramics students sell one-of-a-kind handmade pottery and ceramic art, just in time for holiday gifts.
events.note: Free to browse; prices vary per piece.

events.name: SUU Symphony & Chamber Orchestra Fall Concert
events.place: Okerlund Hall, Eccles Music Center, Southern Utah University
events.description: The SUU Symphony and Chamber Orchestras play Beethoven, Yiping Wang, Arturo Márquez and Aaron Copland under Dr. Xun Sun with guest conductor Dr. Adam Lambert.
events.note: Free concert.

events.name: SUU Food Drive 5K
events.place: Coal Creek Trail, West Canyon Park, 133 S 400 E
events.description: SUU Ambassadors team up with parkrun and Iron County Care and Share for a free community 5K along the Coal Creek Trail.
events.note: Free; bring a non-perishable food item for Iron County Care and Share.
